body:
## Why

Technical spec 5.2, in the bullet "What a whole read gives," says a whole read leaves out each candidate's tier, "which the user sees in the itinerary view and on the option cards." The itinerary view shows no tier. #184 removed its only budget line, and functional spec section 9 lists no tier for stays, legs, or days. Only the option cards show a candidate's tier (functional spec 7.1 and 7.5). The CI review raised it as a note on PR #186, which was merged without the fix, since the fix was this one phrase.

## Do

- In technical spec 5.2, "What a whole read gives," change "which the user sees in the itinerary view and on the option cards" so it says the user sees the tier on the option cards. Check the rest of that sentence still holds for what it lists before the tier: the rationale and the weather text.

## Done when

- The sentence names only where each item it lists is shown.

## Ends in

A PR, docs only.

## Settled in

The PR.
